newsitem.title: USA: Sears hires Merrill M&A executive Susan Field.
newsitem.headline: Sears hires Merrill M&A executive Susan Field.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said Wednesday it hired a mergers and acquisition specialist from Merrill Lynch and Co Inc to be vice president of business development.
The retailer said Susan Field, 38, will direct its business development strategy, including corporate mergers and acquisitions. She will fill the newly created position effective June 23.

Field was a managing director and the head of the retail mergers and acquisitions group at Merrill, Sears said. She assisted Sears in its acquisitions of San Jose, Calif.,-based Orchard Supply Hardware Stores Corp last year and MaxServ Inc, a provider of information services, in March.

"Susan's broad range of experience in mergers and acquisitions, her understanding of the retail business and prior experience with Sears will be important as we continue to create new opportunities to grow our core businesses," said Sears Chief Financial Officer Alan Lacy.

"In her role as managing director and head of the Retail Mergers and Acquisitions Group of Merrill Lynch, Susan added significant value to Sears business development activities, including the company's acquisitions of Orchard Supply Hardware and MaxServ," Lacy said.
